narrative.overview: A proposed visual direction for this prototype, pending user feedback. Warm surfaces and expressive serif headings make space for product photographs. Precise shopping information and calm navigation support browsing. The identity belongs to the merchant; Customelo appears as the platform attribution in the footer.
dos: Do let merchant photography and identity carry the storefront.
Do distinguish real product capabilities from prototype presentation state.
Do preserve actual product prices, customer quotes and merchant policies.
Do support reduced motion and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't invent shipping guarantees, scarcity, review counts or verification badges.
Don't imply every product supports AI Preview or Live Preview.
Don't integrate this prototype with production without a separate approved task.
